_note: Synthetic tool list for the sample Quick Check. Fictional server and company; not a client, not a real product.

tools.name: search_help_articles
tools.description: Search the published help-center articles that Client A's support staff write.

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search support tickets by keyword, status, or requester. Returns subject and the first customer message.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Read one ticket thread, including every message the customer sent.

tools.name: fetch_attachment
tools.description: Download a file linked from a ticket and return its text.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Look up a customer record: name, email, plan, and billing contact.

tools.name: get_integration_token
tools.description: Return the API token for a connected integration so other tools can call it.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's status, assignee, or tags, or add an internal note.

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Email a reply to any address on the ticket.

tools.name: post_slack_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel.
